description: This file defines animation functions for pane transitions in a web application, including entrance and exit animations from offscreen to the right, with Safari-specific workarounds.

methods.name: animatePaneEntranceTransitionFromOffscreenToTheRight
methods.description: Animates a pane element to slide in from offscreen right.

parameters.name: elementId
parameters.description: ID of the DOM element to animate.

methods.name: animatePaneExitTransitionOffscreenToTheRight
methods.description: Animates a pane element to slide out to offscreen right.

parameters.name: elementId
parameters.description: ID of the DOM element to animate.
